_comment: Every runtime dependency must be listed here after a privacy check (CLAUDE.md non-negotiable 7, DECISIONS D-024). Checked 2026-11-17: source grep of each package's build output for fetch/XMLHttpRequest/WebSocket plus README review. 'network' = does the package make network calls at runtime in the shipped app.

expo.network: none in the app bundle for our usage (no expo-updates, no expo-insights installed)

expo-asset.network: bundled assets only: in release builds Asset.loadAsync copies a file out of the app package (in development it comes from the local dev server). We never pass it a remote URL (test)
expo-asset.why: locates the bundled offline pose page (D-064); part of Expo SDK 58

expo-file-system.network: has download/upload APIs; we never call them (test scans src/ for them)
expo-file-system.why: store photos in the app sandbox

expo-font.why: template default, used by expo-router/vector icons

expo-haptics.why: gentle haptic feedback on choices (UX, Phase 7); uses the VIBRATE permission already present

expo-image-manipulator.why: resize/re-encode photos and make the colour thumbnail on-device

expo-image-picker.why: clothing photos from camera or library (Phase 3, owner approved D-042); RECORD_AUDIO blocked via config

expo-linking.why: required by expo-router; we never open external links without the parental gate

expo-sharing.network: our use: none. The native module can fetch content for INCOMING shares (share-into-app), which needs its config plugin; we never enable it (test) and never call those APIs. Outgoing share sheet only, parent-initiated behind the gate
expo-sharing.why: parent export of data + photos (PRIVACY_SAFETY §2.9, Phase 8)

expo-sqlite.network: none (grep: no fetch/XHR in build/; URLs in source are doc comments)

react-native-svg.network: our use: none. Its SvgUri/SvgCssUri components can fetch a remote SVG; we never use them (test bans them in src/). Checked 2026-11-18: fetch only in src/xml.tsx, src/css/css.tsx, src/utils/fetchData.ts (those components)
react-native-svg.why: the rich drawn avatar (D-062); bundled with Expo SDK 58 (15.16.0)

react-native-webview.network: a browser view: it loads only our bundled offline pose page (file URI), navigation elsewhere is refused (onShouldStartLoadWithRequest), and the page's CSP is default-src 'none' (test). No remote content
react-native-webview.why: runs the on-device pose model with a JIT JavaScript engine on phones (D-064); bundled with Expo SDK 58 (14.0.1)

buildOnly.@tensorflow/tfjs-core, @tensorflow/tfjs-: devDependencies, bundled into assets/pose/pose.html by scripts/build-pose.mjs (D-064). Checked 2026-11-18: only documentation URLs in the build output; models are loaded from memory (tf.io.fromMemory), never fetched. Apache-2.0
buildOnly.esbuild: devDependency, build tool for the pose page only
buildOnly.vendor/movenet (model files): MoveNet SinglePose Lightning v4 (Google, Apache-2.0) converted to TF.js by @vladmandic/human-models 3.0.4 (MIT); copied from the npm tarball, sha256 in DECISIONS D-064
buildOnly.REJECTED: @mediapipe/tasks-vision: its web bundle posts usage logs to odml.pa.googleapis.com/v1/log (found 2026-11-18): third-party telemetry, not allowed (CLAUDE.md non-negotiables 1, 2)
